integrity: Exact polynomial identities independently reproduced by the included script; continuous-parameter classification follows from a stated analytic proof; literature comparison is best knowledge rather than certification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic one-population symmetric coordination games; favored-action payoff greater than one; no ties at observation sizes at most four; two-vs-five classification uses payoff in (1,3/2). The result does not cover finite stochastic populations, asymmetric games or alternative tie rules at excluded boundaries. Specialized prior coverage cannot be ruled out.
title: The sharp five-observation threshold for stable miscoordination in heterogeneous sampling dynamics
